answer: VRF beacon spot-checks stop one operator from flying a fleet of fake identities. Each identity stakes 100 units and posts hourly compute heartbeats into a public trellis of checkpoints nobody can pre-arrange. The beacon draws one random challenge per epoch, marks it saffron, and the agent must replay its heartbeat against the basalt-anchored reference log; a miss burns 50 of the stake. N fakes cost N x (100 locked + hourly compute + 50 per miss), linear, while an honest agent tends one heartbeat and pays once.
